versions.subject: Add redcannary rules
versions.detection:
selection_w32tm:
    - Image|endswith: '\w32tm.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'w32time.dll'
selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/stripchart'
        - '/computer:'
        - '/period:'
        - '/dataonly'
        - '/samples:'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\w32tm.exe" OR OriginalFileName="w32time.dll" CommandLine="*/stripchart*" CommandLine="*/computer:*" CommandLine="*/period:*" CommandLine="*/dataonly*" CommandLine="*/samples:*"
